annotations.text:
Recommendation: merge Plan and Progress into one tab, Train.

Header keeps the week ring and streak. A 7-day strip shows planned (hollow), done (filled) and as-planned (filled with ring) on the same day. Today card = the planned workout with Start. Then a sticky segmented control: Calendar · Progress · Records, last segment remembered.

Why this shape: every plan-first app (TrainingPeaks, Intervals, Garmin, Runna, Centr) keeps planned and completed in ONE calendar, and the apps that buried stats behind a merge (MyFitnessPal Apr 2026, Fitbit May 2026) got one-star campaigns. Stats stay one tap away here.

Fourth slot: three tabs (Workouts · Train · Pumpy), which Oura, Apple Fitness and Hevy all run on; the iOS 26 search tab can carry Explore later.

The two alternates, for comparison.

A (calendar hub): strongest for people who plan; stats are one link away, which is the thing users complain about losing.

C (dashboard): zero navigation, best for a today-first product; buries the month grid and records below the fold, the exact pattern behind the MyFitnessPal and Fitbit complaints.
